description: Inline SVG bracket logo with the three-line wordmark, in a light (header) or dark (footer) tone.
name: BracketLogo

description: Footer nav row mirroring the main nav links as plain ink links.
name: FooterNav

description: The page h1, visually hidden so it stays available to screen readers and search engines.
name: HiddenPageTitle

untestabilityReason.justification: one sr-only h1 rendering a single text prop

description: Header home link wrapping the light bracket logo, labelled with the site title.
name: LogoLink

description: Header nav links on the navy band with the call-to-action link as the white button; a dropdown panel below 860px when opened.
name: MainNav

description: Outlined Menu/Close button shown below 860px that reveals the main nav.
name: MenuToggle

description: 404 page body: bracket label, heading, and a link back to the home page.
name: NotFound

description: Home page section placeholder carrying the id the nav links to; later plans fill each one.
name: SectionAnchor

description: Site footer: navy bracket logo, footer nav from nav.json, and the copyright line from settings.footerText.
name: SiteFooter

description: Navy header band from the mockup: bracket-logo home link, main nav from nav.json, and the mobile Menu/Close toggle wired by bindMobileMenu.
name: SiteHeader

description: Wires the mobile Menu/Close toggle: each button click flips the menu and following any nav link closes it.
name: bindMobileMenu

description: Reads the editable nav.json singleton from the active data root on every call.
name: getNav

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read at the data root; the root resolution itself is tested via resolveDataRoot

description: Reads the editable settings.json singleton from the active data root on every call, so CMS edits and seeded scenarios show without a server restart.
name: getSettings

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read at the data root; the root resolution itself is tested via resolveDataRoot

description: True inside astro build, so a production build always resolves committed content and ignores any sandbox override in the environment.
name: isProductionBuild

description: Label for the mobile nav toggle: Close when the menu is open, Menu when closed.
name: menuLabel

description: Reads and parses one JSON singleton (settings or nav) from the active data root, fresh on every call.
name: readSingleton

untestabilityReason.justification: filesystem read and JSON.parse at the data root; root resolution is tested via resolveDataRoot

description: Resolves the content collection root: the CODEYAM_CONTENT_ROOT sandbox override during an editor session, committed src/content otherwise and always in a production build.
name: resolveContentRoot

description: Resolves the site data root for settings.json and nav.json: the CODEYAM_DATA_ROOT sandbox override during an editor session, committed src/data otherwise and always in a production build.
name: resolveDataRoot

description: Shared resolution for the content and data roots: env override during dev and tests, the committed default otherwise and always in production.
name: resolveRoot

description: Opens or closes the mobile nav, keeping the nav's open class, the toggle's aria-expanded, and its label in sync.
name: setMenuOpen

description: Shapes editable nav.json items into header/footer links: skips items without a url, routes hrefs through withBase, and flags the last link as the call-to-action button.
name: toNavLinks

description: Prefixes an internal link or asset path with the active deploy base (the GitHub Pages subpath today, the domain root later); section anchors resolve to the home page and external URLs pass through unchanged.
name: withBase
